name: appeeky/aso-skills
description: An app store optimization (ASO) collection with a router skill that routes intent to a sub-skill and instructs reading that sub-skill file. Sub-skills include Android ASO, A/B testing of store listings, app analytics, and app clips. The verified Android ASO sample covers store listing optimization for Android.
install: npx skills add appeeky/aso-skills. A plugin route is also documented.
